observations: Blue painted cylindrical gearbox, compact cycloidal-style housing with a flanged input side and a yellow output shaft protruding on the other side
Mounted on an integral cast baseplate with four bolt holes
Paint looks fresh and uniform over the whole casting, including the output shaft tip, with no grease, dirt, or operating wear visible
No nameplate, data plate, serial number, or stamped rating visible in any of the three photos
Background is an outdoor brick/tiled floor, consistent with a resale yard, not a running installation
Eye-bolt lifting ring visible on top, consistent with industrial handling
Seller's new message is text only, repeating prior claims, with no new photo or video supplied

claims.evidence: No nameplate or rating plate visible in any photo; HP cannot be read off the casting
No shipping documents, crate labels, or import markings shown

claims.claim: Tested and working (reaffirmed: 'I tested it myself yesterday')
claims.evidence: Still only a verbal assertion; no video or audio of the unit running under load has been provided
Requires running sound/video, still not present
Casting remains freshly repainted in all photos, which can mask prior opening, repair, or wear; no internal or unpainted reference shot given
Housing shape in photo 0 and photo 1 is consistent with a cast iron body, but material cannot be confirmed without a visible unpainted edge or nameplate
No new photo or clip was sent; a verbal reassurance does not constitute photographic or video evidence

risks.risk: Fresh uniform paint may be hiding rust, weld repair, cracks, or a poor casting underneath
risks.proof: Close-up photo of an unpainted or chipped area of the casing, or a photo taken before repainting
risks.if_unproven: priced as a cosmetically refurbished unit of unknown internal condition, not as a clean low-use unit

risks.risk: No nameplate means HP, ratio, and manufacturer cannot be confirmed, which drives price tiering for gear reducers
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the stamped or riveted nameplate/data plate on the housing
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded, unrated generic reducer at the low end of the type

risks.risk: 'Tested and working' and 'no knock' remain unproven by any video or sound; internal gear wear, bearing play, or oil leaks are invisible in static photos or in text
risks.proof: Video clip of the unit running under load (or at least free-running) with audible sound, plus a look at the oil/grease condition
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. worst case as non-functional

risks.risk: Yellow paint fully covering the output shaft is unusual and could be concealing shaft wear, pitting, or a repair
risks.proof: Photo of the shaft with paint removed, or seller statement plus photo showing bare machined shaft surface
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible shaft wear/damage under the paint

risks.risk: Input side coupling/shaft and motor mounting details are not shown, affecting compatibility and completeness
risks.proof: Photo of the input flange/shaft end opposite the yellow output shaft
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete unit unless proven otherwise

proof_requests: Clear photo of the nameplate/data plate showing brand, model, ratio, and HP rating
Video of the unit running (or being hand-turned) with audible sound to support 'tested, no knock'
Close-up photo of an unpainted or worn area of the housing and of the output shaft under the paint
Photo of the input side/shaft coupling
Any import/shipping documentation or photo from origin, if available
response.reason: The seller's reply adds only a verbal reassurance with no new photo or video, so none of the performance, origin, or condition claims move from unverifiable_remote; the item is still priced by type as a used, repainted gear reducer of unconfirmed rating and unconfirmed working condition at worst case until a nameplate and a running clip are supplied.
